title: Isolate the stderr capture fixture from inherited RUST_TEST_NOCAPTURE
outcome: The isolated diagnostic capture fixture obeys its explicit capture-mode arguments even when the parent suite has RUST_TEST_NOCAPTURE enabled.
acceptance: The self-exec stderr fixture's capture mode remains captured when its parent environment enables RUST_TEST_NOCAPTURE, while its explicit direct mode still exercises an actual failing stderr write.
Behavioral verification demonstrates the capture marker and successful zero-panic reporter completion under the inherited-environment condition without weakening the failed-write positive controls.
